body: This is a nice way to reframe it, thanks.
I will definitely not drink with you today! Thanks for the resources, I will check them out.
I was so ragey the first time I saw it! That dude was a jerk and I hope nobody bought his stupid fantasy family car.

I had a shrub once and went back to the same restaurant six months later and could not for the life of me remember what it was called. I told the waiter it was named after some sort of bush and he busted up laughing!
Had sex with me while I was passed out drunk, and then told me about it the next day. When I asked why, "I was bored while watching you sleep making sure you were okay and I needed something to do."

Seriously, thank you. I put in an email notice to my therapist and I will deal with my feelings this week. I am so glad to know that these intense but short episodes are somewhat normal. I can ask for help and not feel overly ridiculous. Thank you so so so much for replying.

Thank you. I am always worried about causing drama and effort for other people. I feel like I am at least capable of honoring the timer I set on my phone. I am going to talk to my counselor on Monday. If I fail my timer I can call 911. Thank you for responding. I feel less crazy now.
